rows.label: qst630201_msg0002
rows.name: When will you come back to me...?

rows.label: qst630201_msg0004
rows.name:
For the Hræsvelgr Mercenaries to speak
to me...

rows.label: qst630201_msg0005
rows.name:
It's Rugena, my daughter... I've
not seen or heard from her ever
since she left for Avaritia...

rows.label: qst630201_msg0008
rows.name:
As expected of the Hræsvelgr
Mercenaries... You promise to reunite
me with my daughter?

rows.label: qst630201_msg0010
rows.name:
My strange daughter said she was going
to buy a stylish hat.
